Introduction

This library provides a comprehensive toolkit for working with structured data pipelines. It builds on established standards to deliver high-throughput, low-latency data processing for analytical workloads.

Installation

Install the library from the official package repository. The package supports current platforms, with optional acceleration extras for large datasets and native parallel execution backends.

Quickstart

Load a sample dataset and perform common operations including schema inference, filtering, and aggregation. Each step maps the high-level API to lower-level primitives.
